source: Anthropic published API prices as listed by the claude-api reference (first-party Claude API, standard speed, prompts up to 100K tokens), read on 2026-11-04. Input, output and the Opus 5.5 / Sonnet 5.5 cache-read prices are published figures. Cache write (5 minute) is the standard 1.25x input; cache write (1 hour) is 2x input; Haiku 5.5 cache read is the standard 0.1x input. Those derived figures match the ratios Endora's own domains/team/src/domain/money.rs uses (Opus $5, Sonnet $2.50, Haiku $0.125 a million written).
note: FROZEN. Do not edit this file to follow a price change: add tariff-v2.json and report both. Every normalized cost in a comparison uses this one file, so the arms are priced identically whatever each was actually charged.

model_notes.local: The house's own model or the owner's Mac (Endora brains Local and Mac): nothing is charged, so its normalized price is zero by definition, not by lack of data.
